constraints.text: The target contains no music, including copied background music.

description.text: An unpopulated railway station platform fills the frame: pale square floor tiles stretch between a row of sturdy platform pillars and the track edge, where parallel rails run away into the distance. Overhead, a suspended sign hangs above the platform and carries the lettering 出口 EXIT 07. The platform is bare, with no travellers, luggage, or moving objects; the surfaces look clean and evenly lit, and the scene remains still. An off-screen narrator's voice begins over this empty view, and because no on-screen character is present, no on-screen lips move.

On the same platform, a commuter train pulls away along the tracks, its carriages sliding past the platform edge and receding down the line beyond the pillars. The platform is left empty behind the departing train, with tiled ground and the overhead sign still in place; no additional lettering appears. The off-screen narrator's voice concludes over the receding train, and since no on-screen character is present, no on-screen lips move.
The commuter train pulls away from the platform and recedes along the tracks, leaving the platform empty behind it.

speakers.description: An off-screen narrator, never visible in frame.
